content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: BIOC(EDR-005 Port Scan Via Bash devtcp) OR BIOC(EDR-005 Batch Mode SSH From Service Account) OR BIOC(EDR-005 SSH Tunnel Creation With Forward Flags) STITCH BY agent_hostname, causality_actor_process_instance_id, actor_effective_username WITHIN 900s
rules.name: Linux Lateral Movement Chain — Recon, Scan, SSH, Tunnel
